message: No detected input validation: The code loads data directly with joblib.load and uses it without any schema, dtype, or value-range validation checks.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from a local file path via an environment variable (DATAPATH) with no checksum verification, authentication, or integrity check of any kind.

No detected label flipping detection: The code counts label occurrences to identify rare classes (count <= 20) but does not validate label values against an expected set, compare distributions for anomalies, or use any label-noise detection tool.
No detected data poisoning defenses: There is no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checking, or filtering of suspicious training samples anywhere in the data-flow path shown.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads a serialized file via `joblib.load(os.environ["DATAPATH"])` without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision to verify the integrity of the loaded artifact.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection implemented anywhere in the training pipeline code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries or mechanisms (Opacus, TF Privacy, DP-SGD) are used anywhere in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing libraries or attack methods (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) are referenced or used anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of a held-out test set isolated from training data, signed/hashed evaluation data, or multiple independent evaluation metrics being enforced; the evaluation relies on cross-validation folds without explicit isolation or integrity checks.
No detected input sanitization: The predict and predict_proba methods in classifier.py pass X_test directly to _predict without any shape, range, schema, or type validation.
No detected output bounds checks: The predict and predict_proba methods return the estimator's raw outputs without any NaN guards, probability bounds checks, or sanity validation.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a tabular classification pipeline (not an LLM), so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
